name: table-cell-split
useCase: Split a selected merged cell in a table editor.
misuse: Do not use this table action as a horizontal resizing control.

16.reason: The outward chevrons stay 1px inside the frame. Short divider ends mark the cell partition without crowding the action marks.

24.reason: Larger outward chevrons keep at least 1.5px to the frame and remain separate from the two divider ends.
